title: Tensor coordinates for affine base change
statement: For commutative rings R, B, R' with algebras R → B and R → R' and a B-module M, the two global-section modules in the affine base-change square admit R'-linear equivalences to R' ⊗[R] M and (R' ⊗[R] B) ⊗[B] M, respectively, carrying canonical generators to pullback-unit sections.

source.place: Lemma 01I9 (1),(2), used in Cohomology Lemma 02KG affine computation

proof.text: Use the unit-compatible pullback-tilde comparison and tilde.isoTop to identify tensor products with global sections of the tensor pullback of a tilde module. For a quasi-coherent affine module, transport this comparison through the isomorphism fromTildeΓ; naturality of the pullback unit and fromTildeΓ_app_toOpen give the unit formula.

Mathlib isIso_fromTildeΓ_pushforward makes pushforward of tilde quasi-coherent. Identify its global sections with the original module restricted to R using tilde.isoTop and pushforwardSpecMapCompΓIso. Tensor this identification with R′ and compose with the preceding comparison to construct a.

Apply the tilde tensor-pullback comparison over B to D = R′ tensor_R B, restrict scalars from D to R′, and use pushforwardSpecMapCompΓIso to construct b. The two unit formulas give the required equations; tensor balancing identifies (1 tensor z) tensor m with 1 tensor (z smul m).

lean.statement:
theorem exists_affineBaseChange_tensorComparisons
    (R B R' : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [CommRing R']
    [Algebra R B] [Algebra R R'] (M : ModuleCat.{u} B) :
    letI : Module R M := Module.compHom M (algebraMap R B)
    letI : Algebra B (R' ⊗[R] B) := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
    ∃ (a : ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of R')).obj
        ((tensorPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R')))).obj
          ((pushforward (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B)))).obj
            (tilde (R := .of B) M)))) ≃ₗ[R'] R' ⊗[R] M)
      (b : ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of R')).obj
        ((pushforward (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R' (R' ⊗[R] B))))).obj
          ((tensorPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B (R' ⊗[R] B))))).obj
            (tilde (R := .of B) M)))) ≃ₗ[R'] (R' ⊗[R] B) ⊗[B] M),
      (∀ m : M, a.symm ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] m) =
        (((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R'))))).unit.app
          ((pushforward (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B)))).obj
            (tilde (R := .of B) M))).val.app (op ⊤)
            (tilde.toOpen (R := .of B) M ⊤ m) :
          (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of R')).obj
            ((tensorPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R')))).obj
              ((pushforward (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B)))).obj
                (tilde (R := .of B) M))))) ∧
      (∀ (z : B) (m : M), b.symm (((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] z) ⊗ₜ[B] m) =
        (((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B (R' ⊗[R] B)))))).unit.app
          (tilde (R := .of B) M)).val.app (op ⊤)
            (tilde.toOpen (R := .of B) M ⊤ (z • m)) :
          (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of R')).obj
            ((pushforward (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R' (R' ⊗[R] B))))).obj
              ((tensorPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B (R' ⊗[R] B))))).obj
                (tilde (R := .of B) M)))))
